scenes.say: Pirates didn't wear eye patches because they lost an eye.
Life on a ship meant blinding sun up on deck.
scenes.heading: ON DECK

scenes.say: And almost total darkness below it. Fire on a wooden ship was dangerous.
scenes.heading: BELOW DECK
scenes.sub: fire on a wooden ship = danger

scenes.say: Going from bright light to darkness, your eyes can need up to twenty-five minutes to adjust.
scenes.label: to adjust to darkness

scenes.say: So here's the theory. Keep one eye covered, already used to the dark.
scenes.heading: THE THEORY

scenes.say: Then, when you go below deck, flip the patch. And see instantly.
MythBusters tested it and called it plausible. But there's no historical proof pirates actually did it.
scenes.heading: THE VERDICT
